forecast_live_alignment_finding.finding: The reviewed forecast copied reference-branch future physical actions for non-focal users during hold, while live execution recomputed Main on the live option branch and overrode only the focal user.
forecast_live_alignment_finding.preferred_alignment: Both paths must recompute frozen Main on their own contemporaneous branch input, override only the focal user at hold offsets 0 through 2, and execute complete branch-local Main at release offset 3. Cross-world non-focal action equality is not required; branch-local Main policy alignment is required.

h3_adjudication: Retain fixed H=3 for the alignment retest because the pre-fix four-seed evidence established reachability and heterogeneity. Do not select adaptive H before removing the policy confound.
warmup_adjudication: Do not add warm-up to repair policy alignment; it changes the checkpoint and anchor distribution and needs separate evidence.
minimum_changes: Use one shared candidate-local Main focal-hold compositor in forecast and live execution.
Replace cross-world non-focal physical identity with branch-local Main policy alignment.
Hash-bind checkpoint, objective weights, policy/compositor versions, per-offset inputs, Main outputs and composed outputs.
Version and segregate pre-fix certificates and learning receipts.

postfix_gate.required: At least two independent fixed seeds contain one K>=2 schedule after alignment.
postfix_gate.claim_limit: Opportunity and mechanics only; no EE efficacy, superiority, Chapter-5 or deployment claim.
